description: A close English retelling of the Norwegian folktale, keeping the brisk, plainspoken voice and episodic journey: Halvor the hearth-sitter grows into a troll-slayer, breaks a taboo that costs him his princess, and wins her back at Soria Moria Castle through wit and endurance.
tone: Folktale adventure with plain humor, wonder, and steadfast romance
summary: A lazy ash-boy becomes a troll-slayer and races the winds to reclaim his stolen bride at Soria Moria Castle.
